description: System Dynamics Vensim Model for Assessing EV Charging Infrastructure Profitability Along the Guaymas–Phoenix Transborder Corridor is a model or code deposit deposited in Figshare by its authors Armando Elizondo Noriega. This repository contains the Vensim System Dynamics model (both Spanish and English versions) developed to evaluate the operational feasibility and profitability of EV charging infrastructure along the Guaymas–San Carlos, Sonora, Mexico, to Phoenix, Arizona, USA corridor. Coverage: several countries (ES, MX, US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 288982 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
